description: Look up a legal entity in the CMF registers by RUT or name. Returns (1) supervised-entity register hits: CMF code, name, entity type and whether the registration is current; and (2) the register of financial service providers created by Chile's Fintec law, with the services each provider is authorised for (crowdfunding platform, alternative trading system, credit advice, investment advice, custody, order routing, intermediation) and status. RUT may be written 77.532.023-0 or 77532023. An absent entity returns found:false with the scope searched, which means 'not in these registers', not 'does not exist'. Natural persons are never returned.

name.description: Entity name or part of it, e.g. "Abaqus".

rut.description: Chilean RUT of the entity, e.g. "77.532.023-0".

name: cmf_registry
